lead: Coalition week hits its climax: the ANC's NEC meets today as a four-party pact puts Herman Mashaba in line for Joburg mayor and MK pushes for eThekwini, while the rand sits at a 2026 low but a big December petrol cut is forecast.

items.title: ANC NEC meets as four-party pact eyes Gauteng metros
items.summary: The ANC, ActionSA, MK and EFF are shaping up as the core of governments in Johannesburg, Tshwane and Ekurhuleni, with ActionSA's Herman Mashaba likely to become Joburg mayor this week. Joburg council sits today to elect a Speaker.

items.title: MK offers ANC eThekwini co-governance in exchange for KZN backing
items.summary: MK, the biggest party in eThekwini, has reportedly proposed sharing power in the metro if the ANC supports it governing KwaZulu-Natal. ANC KZN negotiator Mike Mabuyakhulu, who favours the ANC-DA-IFP model, has reportedly been sidelined.

items.title: DA offers ANC 93 mayoralties across 137 hung councils
items.summary: The DA's written 'stability framework' would let the ANC lead 93 hung councils, the DA 24 and the IFP 20. In KZN it gives the DA eThekwini and Msunduzi. ActionSA has rejected the DA's Gauteng offer.

items.title: Nation mourns former deputy president Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka
items.summary: Flags are at half-mast after Mlambo-Ngcuka died on Friday aged 71. A state memorial service is set for Tuesday in Rivonia, followed by a state funeral at eXesi in the Eastern Cape on Saturday.

items.title: Durban container terminal backlog hits nine-day waits
items.summary: Ships waited an average of nine days at anchorage for Durban Gateway Terminal in mid-November, against near-zero at other ports. Transnet is diverting some Durban-bound boxes to Ngqura as the private rail reform also faces debt hurdles.

items.title: Overberg wildfire burns 25,000ha and destroys 24 homes
items.summary: Most of the homes were lost at Riverine near Malgas on Saturday. The district municipality said the threat to homes had stabilised overnight, but crews were still fighting the fire on several fronts including De Hoop Nature Reserve.

items.title: 30 arrested in four-day Eastern Cape police operation
items.summary: Police in the Sarah Baartman district arrested 30 suspects and seized drugs, ammunition and suspected stolen goods worth over R1.68m, including 4.4kg of tik found at a home in Makhanda.

items.title: Dirco warns young women about Lagos dancer job offer
items.summary: Dirco's Clayson Monyela cautioned that an advertised paid-for dancing job in Lagos could be a trafficking risk, said the matter had been reported for investigation, and pointed people to the national trafficking hotline.

items.title: COP31 climate talks in Turkey end without a deal
items.summary: The EU and others rejected the final text as too weak, including its silence on fossil fuels, after the longest COP on record. It is the first UN climate summit since Copenhagen in 2009 to fail to adopt a deal.

items.title: Iran says tankers set alight in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Iran's navy said tankers that breached its rules in a restricted zone east of the strait were set on fire, with Iranian media reporting two oil tankers ablaze as the US-Iran war continues to hit shipping.

items.title: Drone-hit Russian cargo ship burns off Finland
items.summary: The sanctioned Sparta II, bound for Kaliningrad, was struck by drones in the Gulf of Finland and drifted into Finnish waters. Its 16 crew were evacuated; Finland's military said Ukraine was the likely attacker.

items.title: Libya suspects drone attack on Russian ship in Benghazi
items.summary: Eastern Libyan authorities said a suspected drone strike caused an explosion on a Russian vessel at Benghazi naval base, lightly injuring ten people. No one has claimed responsibility.

items.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi drone aimed at Riyadh
items.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it downed a drone and a missile, while Houthi media reported an air strike on a fuel station in Sanaa that injured six workers.

items.title: Indonesia sweets factory fire kills three, 36 missing
items.summary: A blaze at a snack factory in Banten province near Jakarta was still burning more than 12 hours later. About 60 people were inside when it started; the cause is under investigation.

items.title: Rand slides to 2026 low after worst global market week since 2020
items.summary: The rand ended Friday near R17.59 to the dollar, about 7% weaker than on 9 November, as US shares fell sharply for the week. Gold dropped to around $3,522 an ounce and the JSE is down nearly 10% this year.

items.title: Petrol could fall R3 to R4 a litre in December
items.summary: Economists expect a large fuel price cut at the start of December, offering motorists some relief despite the weaker rand.

items.title: SARB kept repo at 7.25% as coalition jitters hit the rand
items.summary: The Reserve Bank held rates last Thursday with October inflation at 5.2%. Uncertainty over Johannesburg and Tshwane coalitions added to pressure on the rand and JSE.

items.title: Proteas start second Test against Bangladesh at Centurion today
items.summary: Aiden Markram captains in place of the injured Temba Bavuma, with Tony de Zorzi and Anrich Nortje coming in. South Africa lead the two-match series after winning at the Wanderers by nine wickets. Play starts at 10am.

items.title: Pirates beat Stellenbosch 2-0 in Durban to reach Carling Knockout final
items.summary: Substitute Evidence Makgopa scored both goals at Moses Mabhida Stadium on Saturday as the holders booked another final. Stellies coach Gavin Hunt felt his side controlled the game.

items.title: England thump All Blacks 37-12 at Twickenham
items.summary: England scored five tries for a fifth straight Test win and their first back-to-back victories over New Zealand since 2002-03, with Ben Earl named player of the match.

items.title: OpenAI's chief scientist proposes a shared limit on frontier training
items.summary: Jakub Pachocki published internal model-quality figures for the first time and suggested leading labs agree not to push past a set threshold until safety monitoring catches up.

items.title: Lean maths community certifies formal Riemann Hypothesis proof
items.summary: Maintainers of the Lean proof assistant and its Mathlib library said a machine-checked proof posted on 20 November compiles without errors. The endorsement covers the formal check, not wider peer review.

items.title: Trump signals joint AI guardrails with China
items.summary: Semafor reported the US president said Washington would work with Beijing on shared AI safeguards, a shift from his earlier opposition to global AI rules.
